title: Glowing sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- outer nori wrap: deep purple-blue so it glows on Doot's screen -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='36' fill='#3a2a5a'/>
  <!-- nori highlight for edge definition -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='36' fill='none' stroke='#5c4a8a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- inner rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='28' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <!-- rice speckles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='40' r='2.2' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='2' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='60' r='2' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='58' r='2.4' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='2' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='50' r='2' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='50' r='1.8' fill='#e8e2d0'/>
  <!-- salmon filling: bright orange -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#ff7a30'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='16' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ffb070' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- salmon stripes -->
  <path d='M40 45 Q50 42 60 45' stroke='#ff9a50' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M39 51 Q50 48 61 51' stroke='#ff9a50' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M41 57 Q50 54 59 57' stroke='#ff9a50' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cucumber accent: bright green -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#4ad46a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='46' r='1.2' fill='#a8f0b8'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='54' r='3' fill='#4ad46a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='54' r='1' fill='#a8f0b8'/>
  <!-- avocado accent: soft green -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='44' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#9be05a'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='56' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#9be05a'/>
  <!-- cute face on the roll -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='46' r='2' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='46' r='2' fill='#2a1a4a'/>
  <path d='M46 52 Q50 56 54 52' stroke='#2a1a4a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff9a50' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff9a50' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- glow sparkles -->
  <path d='M22 22 L24 28 L30 30 L24 32 L22 38 L20 32 L14 30 L20 28 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M78 18 L79.5 22 L84 24 L79.5 26 L78 30 L76.5 26 L72 24 L76.5 22 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M80 70 L81.5 74 L86 76 L81.5 78 L80 82 L78.5 78 L74 76 L78.5 74 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='30' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
